(Opening · Drone panoramic pull-up, with gentle interstellar wind sound)
A Date Among the Stars, Dreams Woven in Cyberworld
The drone ascends, unfolding a full view of the alien planet from a god’s-eye perspective. A ringed celestial body hangs above the pink-purple dome, with a brilliant galaxy pouring down. Mountainous seas of flowers undulate in soft blue-green light, where snow-capped mountains and futuristic architecture are hidden among layered greenery. Every frame presents magnificent romance across dimensions.
(Transition · Drone rapid downward overhead shot + orbital movement, connecting to medium shot, with subtle electronic sound effects)
The camera breaks through the clouds and glides close to the ground, skimming the winding reflections of the galaxy toward a futuristic settlement deep in the flowers. Pink-purple paths stretch forward, giant irises entwine technological pillars, transparent domes refract shattered starlight, and flying-saucer-shaped buildings float among them—wild nature collides perfectly with futuristic edge.
(Transition · Drone macro push + focus shift, close-up, soft petal rustling sound rising)
The drone shoots at extremely close range, passing through layers of flower shadows, with macro focus capturing every texture of alien flora. Purple iris petals glow with gradient luster, stamen textures are clearly visible, dotted with tiny pink flowers. Between focus shifts, soft light wraps trembling petals, blending cyber romance into every detail.
(Transition · Drone follow-up pull-up + orbital rotation, dynamic shots, galaxy swirling sound fading in)
The drone ascends smoothly, following the flowing galaxy, circling along the arc of shooting stars. Petals and green plants sway gently in the wind, while paths and buildings gradually recede in the frame. Constellations rotate and connect clearly, warm and cool colors interweave. Every camera movement holds unexpected dreamlike surprises.
(Transition · Drone sudden stop + slow-motion pullback, impactful shot, wind sound synced to beats)
The camera freezes abruptly, pulling back in slow motion, capturing flower seas, green trees, futuristic architecture and celestial bodies all in one frame. Pink-purple and blue-green collide with extreme tension. The faint glow of the swirling galaxy and the swaying arc of petals are amplified in slow motion, freezing the peak of this cyber dream in a stunning moment.
(Ending · Drone pull-back to panorama + fixed hover, still frame closing, sound effects fading out)
The drone slowly ascends and hovers at a panoramic view, embracing the entire starry flower realm. The ringed celestial body still hangs above the dome, the galaxy flows gently, the flower sea undulates quietly, and the futuristic settlement rests among greenery. Noise fades away, leaving only the healing harmony of cyber and nature. The dream ends, but romance remains eternal.
(No character dialogue throughout. The rhythm matches drone movement and sound changes, emphasizing coolness and dreaminess, suitable for image-to-video visual narration.)
